# MFJ Grant Strategies

> Strategic federal grants management, compliance, and consulting for tribal
> nations, municipalities, state agencies, and nonprofits. Founded by
> Matthew F. Johnston, who has worked every side of the federal funding
> table: funder (USAID), research recipient (VCU), tribal-government
> recipient (Oneida Indian Nation), and independent federal grant reviewer.

## About
- [MFJ Grant Strategies](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/): Firm overview, founder background, services, and process.
- [Services](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/services.html): Every service by function and by sector, with engagement models.
- [How We Work](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/how-we-work.html): The four-phase engagement process and fee principles (flat fee or retainer, never contingency).
- [FAQ](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/faq.html): Fees, timelines, guarantees, what the portfolio figures mean, 2 CFR 200, and the Single Audit.
- [Contact](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/contact.html): Book an initial consultation.

## Founder
- [Matthew F. Johnston](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/about-matt.html), Founder & Principal. Former USAID grants officer (funder side), research-administration experience at VCU College of Engineering (R1 recipient), grants role with the Oneida Indian Nation (tribal recipient), and independent federal grant reviewer. Roughly $425M in federal funding administered or supported across 13 federal agencies over that career; these are portfolios administered, not funds personally awarded or raised. The founder page states precisely what each figure means. Deep fluency in 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance). Member of the National Grants Management Association (NGMA). Advanced working knowledge of the federal grant systems: Grants.gov, SAM.gov, SimplerGrants.gov, and USAspending.gov.

## Services
- [Grant Writing Services](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/grant-writing-services.html): Professional grant writing and proposal development for federal, state, local, and foundation funding. Nonprofit grant writing, government grant writing, tribal grant writing. Narrative and budget written to the scoring rubric. Never contingency. Focused on grant funding, not general fundraising.
- [Federal & State Grants Consultant](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/federal-and-state-grants-consultant.html): What a grants consultant does across federal and state funding, the difference between direct federal, state pass-through, and state-funded awards, and how an engagement runs. Richmond, Virginia; nationwide.
- [Federal Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/federal-grants-management.html): Post-award administration from award setup to closeout.
- [2 CFR 200 Compliance Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/2-cfr-200-compliance.html): Uniform Guidance compliance, internal controls, and Single Audit readiness.
- [Tribal Grant Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/tribal-grant-consulting.html): Federal funding strategy, 638 contracting, and compliance for tribal governments.
- [USAID & Federal Assistance Award Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/usaid-grant-management.html): Award management for NGOs and development organizations, informed by funder-side USAID experience.
- [Federal Grant Readiness Assessments](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/grant-readiness-assessments.html): An honest read on capacity, financial health, and documentation before applying.
- [Municipal Grant Consulting](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/municipal-grant-consulting.html): Cross-agency federal funding strategy and administration for cities and counties.
- [Higher Education & Research Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/higher-education-grants-management.html): Sponsored programs and research administration for universities and research institutions.
- [Nonprofit & International NGO Grants Management](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/nonprofit-ngo-grants-management.html): Award administration, compliance, and diversified funding strategy for nonprofits and NGOs.
- [Federal Funding Strategy](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/federal-funding-strategy.html): Opportunity identification and cross-agency portfolio development.
- [Fractional Grants Department](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/fractional-grants-department.html): An outsourced, part-time grants office on a monthly retainer, covering research, proposals, administration, compliance, reporting, and training. Never contingency-based.
- Post-award grant administration, grant portfolio management, and grant strategy and development.

## Who We Serve
- Tribal nations and tribally-owned organizations
- Municipal, county, and state governments
- Nonprofit organizations
- Healthcare organizations
- Housing & community development

## Expertise
- 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance) compliance and audit readiness
- Post-award administration: financial reporting, procurement, cost share, subrecipient monitoring, closeout
- Federal funding across HUD, DOT, DOJ, USDA, EPA, HHS/HRSA/CMS, BIA, IHS
- Grant portfolio management and institutional capacity building

## Location
- Based in Richmond, Virginia. Serving clients nationwide.

## Tools & Examples
- [Single Audit Readiness Scorecard](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/single-audit-readiness-scorecard.html): Free twelve-question self-assessment of internal controls against the areas a Single Audit under 2 CFR 200 Subpart F examines. Illustrative; not an audit.

## Knowledge Center articles (by Matthew F. Johnston, published 2026-11-07)
- [The Complete Guide to 2 CFR 200 for Nonprofit Organizations](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/2-cfr-200-guide-for-nonprofits.html): The Uniform Guidance subpart by subpart, the five allowability tests, the Single Audit, and where nonprofits stumble.
- [How to Prepare Your Organization for a Federal Grant Audit](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/how-to-prepare-for-a-federal-grant-audit.html): What a Single Audit examines, auditee responsibilities, and the records trail to build in advance.
- [Seven Reasons Federal Grant Applications Fail Before Submission](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/why-federal-grant-applications-fail.html): Strategic mistakes made before a reviewer reads a word.
- [How Tribal Governments Can Build Sustainable Federal Funding Portfolios](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/tribal-federal-funding-portfolios.html): 638 contracts and compacts, formula funding, competitive awards, one grants office, indirect costs and contract support.
- [What Federal Grant Reviewers Look For in Competitive Applications](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/what-federal-grant-reviewers-look-for.html): How objective review panels score, from a former independent reviewer.
- [Winning a Federal Grant vs. Successfully Administering One](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/winning-vs-administering-federal-grants.html): The post-award obligations that start at the award letter.
- [How to Establish an Effective Grants Management Department](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/how-to-build-a-grants-management-department.html): Functions, required written policies, systems, sizing, and when a fractional model fits.
- [USAID Award Administration: Lessons for Federal Grant Recipients](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/usaid-award-administration-lessons.html): What funder-side administration teaches every recipient.

## Guides & Resources
- [Federal Grants Knowledge Center](https://mfjgrantstrategies.com/knowledge-center.html): Educational articles and original analysis on 2 CFR 200, funding strategy, tribal funding, administration, compliance, and institutional capacity (eight signature articles published).
